repo.description:
### Summary

When the admin email was configured but the admin password was left empty, NocoDB skipped environment-based super-admin bootstrap silently, leaving first-user signup open so that the first unauthenticated caller became super admin.

### Details

`initAdminFromEnv.ts` gated the entire bootstrap on both the admin email and the admin password environment variables being truthy. An empty string is falsy, so an empty password caused the whole function body to be skipped: no admin row was inserted, no error was raised, and no warning was logged. `UsersService.signup()` grants the first user on a non-cloud instance the organisation Creator and Super Admin roles - a branch that normally never fires, because bootstrap has already created the first user row before the HTTP surface is reachable. An operator who set the admin email and left the password blank therefore booted an instance that appeared configured while public first-user registration was still open.

### Impact

On a fresh instance in this configuration, the first caller of the public signup endpoint received org-level Creator and Super Admin roles, i.e. full administrative control of the deployment. No authentication is required. The exposure is limited to the initial-setup window before any user row exists, and it does not bypass an admin account that was successfully created.

### Credit

This issue was reported by [@sec-reex](https://github.com/sec-reex).
repo.summary: Privilege Escalation via Incomplete Admin Bootstrap
